path.name: allocation-etl
path.description: Daily Black Diamond file ingestion into silver layer

step.description: EventBridge rule bd-transaction-pipeline-trigger fires at 21:40 UTC (Mon-Fri)

bd-transactions-trigger starts bd-transactions EC2 (i-00c7568bc510f7423) via SSM. SSM document opal-bd-transaction-download runs on the instance, downloads transaction XLSX files from Black Diamond using stored credentials (Secrets Manager: opal/bd/credentials), and uploads them to s3://opal-data-bd/forwardfill_v2/transactions/.
step.triggers: opal-bd-transaction-download SSM document on bd-transactions EC2

step.description: EventBridge rule bd-allocation-pipeline-trigger fires at 21:48 UTC (Mon-Fri), 8 minutes after transactions to allow slight stagger.

bd-allocation-trigger starts bd-allocations EC2 (i-0800437d1dbb0b5cc) via SSM. SSM document opal-bd-allocation-download runs, downloads allocation XLSX from Black Diamond, uploads to s3://opal-data-bd/forwardfill_v2/allocations/.
step.triggers: opal-bd-allocation-download SSM document on bd-allocations EC2

step.description: S3 ObjectCreated event on opal-data-bd prefix=forwardfill_v2/allocations/ suffix=.xlsx triggers bd-allocation-processor Lambda.

bd-allocation-processor reads the Excel allocation file (openpyxl layer), transforms and normalizes allocation data using pandas (pandas-pyarrow layer), writes silver-layer parquet outputs to s3://opal-data-bd/silver/. On completion, invokes bd-price-update Lambda (Lambda-to-Lambda, async).

bd-price-update Lambda fetches current-day market prices via yfinance for all tickers in the silver allocation data. Writes dated price parquet s3://opal-data-bd/silver/prices/YYYY-MM-DD.parquet. On completion, invokes bd-gold-trigger Lambda (Lambda-to-Lambda, via bd-processor-chain IAM).

step.note: Also triggered independently by S3 event — see PATH B
step.description: bd-gold-trigger Lambda receives invoke. Checks GOLD_INSTANCE_ID env var (i-01003b035d2988dfb = bd-gold-layer-runner). Starts the EC2 instance via EC2 API. EC2 instance runs run-gold-layer.sh (incremental mode) on boot via systemd.

path.name: prices-s3-trigger
path.description: S3-native trigger for gold layer when prices parquet lands

step.description: S3 ObjectCreated event on opal-data-bd prefix=silver/prices/20 suffix=.parquet. Filter prefix 20 matches dated files (e.g. 2026-02-24.parquet) but NOT canonical_prices.parquet (starts with c).
bd-gold-trigger starts bd-gold-layer-runner EC2. Continues at Gold Layer Execution below.

path.name: gold-layer-ec2-execution
path.description: EC2 gold layer computation — incremental or full

step.description: bd-gold-layer-runner EC2 (i-01003b035d2988dfb, r6i.xlarge) boots. systemd starts run-gold-layer.sh. Script self-updates by pulling latest runner from s3://opal-data-bd/code/runner/run-gold-layer.sh.
run-gold-layer.sh syncs gold scripts from s3://opal-data-bd/code/gold/ into /home/ubuntu/gold-layer/scripts/, then executes run_gold_layer.sh with the requested mode (incremental or full).

run_gold_layer.sh executes numbered Python scripts sequentially. Incremental: 02, 05, 07, 08, 09, 10. Full (monthly): 00, 01, 02, 04, 03, 05, 05b, 06, 07, 08, 09, 10. See gold_layer_stages section for per-script details.

On script completion, run_gold_layer.sh writes sentinel: s3://opal-data-bd/gold/pipeline-complete.json with status, mode, timestamp. Then initiates CloudFront invalidation on distribution EVTSA9VEHNZVH (path: /api/scoped/advisor-intelligence/*). Then shuts down the instance.

S3 ObjectCreated event on opal-data-bd prefix=gold/pipeline-complete suffix=.json triggers bd-portal-publisher Lambda (4096 MB, 900s). bd-portal-publisher reads gold parquets from opal-data-bd, builds portal JSON output files, and writes them back to opal-data-bd portal paths. CONCURRENTLY: bd-portal-publisher async-invokes bd-portal-advisor-publisher at startup (Lambda-to-Lambda). S3 does not allow two notification rules with identical prefix+suffix filter on the same bucket+event, so fan-out is achieved via Lambda-to-Lambda.

bd-portal-advisor-publisher Lambda (6144 MB, 900s) reads gold parquets and builds per-advisor intelligence views, writes per-advisor JSON to s3://opal-data-bd/ portal paths. Serves AdvisorIntelligence portal views.

path.name: historical-prices
path.description: Ephemeral EC2 yfinance historical price fetch

step.description: EventBridge rule historical-prices-daily fires at 14:00 UTC (9:00 AM ET) daily, all days including weekends.

historical-prices-scheduler Lambda launches ephemeral EC2 (t3.xlarge) with bd-exporter-ec2-role (profile: bd-exporter-profile). The ephemeral instance uses AMI ami-0c1fe732b5494dc14. Code is baked into user-data at launch time (not deployed via S3 artifact model — ephemeral pattern).

Ephemeral EC2 fetches historical price data via yfinance for all tickers. Writes s3://opal-data-bd/silver/historical_prices.parquet (T2 price source). Instance terminates itself after completion (ec2:TerminateInstances on tag ManagedBy=lambda-scheduler).

path.name: monthly-gold-rebuild
path.description: Full gold layer rebuild on 1st of month at 3 AM ET

step.description: EventBridge rule bd-gold-layer-monthly-trigger fires at 08:00 UTC (3:00 AM ET) on the 1st of every month.
bd-gold-trigger starts bd-gold-layer-runner EC2. Passes mode=full. EC2 runs run_gold_layer.sh full: all 12 scripts in dependency order. See gold_layer_stages for full sequence.

path.name: allocation-file-check
path.description: Guard: SNS alert if allocation file missing after ETL window

step.description: EventBridge rule bd-allocation-file-check-daily fires at 22:30 UTC (5:30 PM ET) Mon-Fri, 1 hour after the allocation ETL window.
bd-allocation-file-checker checks s3://opal-data-bd for today's allocation file. If missing, publishes alert to SNS topic bd-allocation-file-missing.

lambda.name: bd-allocation-trigger
lambda.role_in_pipeline: Starts bd-allocations EC2 via SSM; SSM document downloads allocation XLSX from Black Diamond to s3://opal-data-bd/forwardfill_v2/allocations/

lambda.name: bd-transactions-trigger
lambda.role_in_pipeline: Starts bd-transactions EC2 via SSM; SSM document downloads transaction XLSX from Black Diamond to s3://opal-data-bd/forwardfill_v2/transactions/

lambda.name: bd-fees-trigger
lambda.role_in_pipeline: Starts bd-fees EC2 via SSM document opal-bd-fees-download. SSM doc runs download-daily-fees.ts (Playwright -> BD Data Mining -> Fees_OpalCapital_Daily template) -> uploads to s3://opal-data-bd/bronze/fees/Fees_OpalCapital_Daily_{start}_to_{end}.xlsx -> runs convert_fees_to_silver.py --latest -> writes silver/fees/YYYY-MM-DD.parquet. Fees pipeline is STANDALONE: does NOT invoke bd-price-update or bd-gold-trigger. silver/fees/ is consumed by bd-portal-publisher + bd-portal-advisor-publisher which run AFTER gold completes via the pipeline-complete.json sentinel.

lambda.name: bd-allocation-processor
lambda.trigger: S3 ObjectCreated on opal-data-bd prefix=forwardfill_v2/allocations/ suffix=.xlsx
lambda.role_in_pipeline: Reads allocation XLSX using openpyxl, transforms data with pandas, writes silver parquet to opal-data-bd/silver/. Invokes bd-price-update Lambda on completion (Lambda-to-Lambda).

lambda.name: bd-price-update
lambda.role_in_pipeline: Fetches daily market prices via yfinance for all allocation tickers. Writes silver/prices/YYYY-MM-DD.parquet. Invokes bd-gold-trigger on completion (Lambda-to-Lambda, via bd-processor-chain IAM policy).

lambda.name: bd-gold-trigger
lambda.role_in_pipeline: Starts bd-gold-layer-runner EC2 (i-01003b035d2988dfb). Passes run mode (incremental or full). EC2 boots and runs run-gold-layer.sh via systemd.

lambda.name: bd-gold-layer
lambda.trigger: Not directly S3- or EventBridge-triggered per Terraform. Likely invoked programmatically or via Step Functions migration path.
lambda.role_in_pipeline: Large-memory (10240 MB) gold computation Lambda. Role allows S3 read/write on opal-data-bd and Lambda invoke of bd-portal-advisor-publisher. May be a pre-EC2 computation stage or Step Functions orchestration target. Active in Terraform and source map; trigger confirmed from source code review of IAM alone.

lambda.name: bd-gold-foundation
lambda.trigger: Step Functions target (bd-gold-step-functions-role can invoke). Stage 1 of planned Step Functions gold pipeline.
lambda.role_in_pipeline: Gold layer Stage 1 foundation computation. Step Functions target for planned bd-gold-pipeline state machine migration.

lambda.name: bd-gold-detail-checker
lambda.trigger: Step Functions target (bd-gold-step-functions-role can invoke). Stage 4 EC2 completion check.
lambda.role_in_pipeline: Polls S3 for EC2 gold detail completion signal. Stage 4 of planned Step Functions gold pipeline. Lightweight 128 MB poller.

lambda.name: bd-portal-publisher
lambda.trigger: S3 ObjectCreated on opal-data-bd prefix=gold/pipeline-complete suffix=.json
lambda.role_in_pipeline: Reads gold parquets from opal-data-bd, builds portal JSON output files. Three-way fan-out: (1) at handler START invokes bd-portal-advisor-publisher async, (2) after all writes complete invokes bd-capture-output-versions async. Lambda-to-Lambda fan-out required for both — S3 does not allow two notification rules with identical prefix+suffix filters.

lambda.name: bd-portal-advisor-publisher
lambda.status: DECOMMISSIONED (ADHC_BDTSCLB.001) — superseded by D_02 + gold chain; see comment above

lambda.name: bd-client-detail
lambda.trigger: On-demand — invoked by API Gateway (routing configured in CloudFront distribution EVTSA9VEHNZVH)
lambda.role_in_pipeline: Per-client detail API. Invoked on-demand when a portal user requests a specific client's detail view. Reads gold parquets and returns client-scoped data. Not part of the batch pipeline; runs independently of the ETL schedule.

lambda.name: bd-allocation-file-checker
lambda.role_in_pipeline: Guard Lambda. Checks if today's allocation file is present in s3://opal-data-bd. If missing, publishes alert to SNS topic bd-allocation-file-missing. Not part of data pipeline; monitoring only. Managed with lifecycle ignore_changes — not updated via standard Terraform artifact pipeline.

lambda.name: historical-prices-scheduler
lambda.trigger: EventBridge historical-prices-daily (cron 14:00 UTC daily, all days)
lambda.role_in_pipeline: Spawns ephemeral EC2 (t3.xlarge, AMI ami-0c1fe732b5494dc14) with bd-exporter-ec2-role. Ephemeral instance fetches historical prices via yfinance and writes silver/historical_prices.parquet (T2 price source for gold layer). BD pipeline asset despite non-bd- prefix. Imported from manual creation 2026-02-13.

lambda.name: bd-capture-output-versions
lambda.trigger: Lambda-to-Lambda async from bd-portal-publisher (at handler END, after all gold/ writes)
lambda.role_in_pipeline: Time Machine Layer 2 (DRFR_PTMCH.P3). Lists all gold/ objects, records current VersionId of each via head_object, writes timestamped manifest to snapshots/manifests/{YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS}.json. Provides fast O(1) version lookup for bd-time-machine without scanning full version history per-key. One manifest per rebuild, permanent audit log.

lambda.name: bd-time-machine
lambda.role_in_pipeline: Time Machine Layer 2 restore (DRFR_PTMCH.P3). Finds latest manifest at or before 17:00 ET on target_date, CopyObjects each gold/ key to recorded VersionId, writes pipeline-complete.json sentinel to trigger bd-portal-publisher re-publish, invalidates CloudFront /api/scoped/advisor-intelligence/*. Fallback: list_object_versions per key for pre-manifest history (earliest: 2026-02-25). Patch bd-v2.18.1: try/except around copy_object in both restore paths, tuple return signatures, no MetadataDirective=REPLACE.

stage.produces: gold/accounts_dimension_latest.parquet (~6k accounts with enriched metadata: architect, tax_status, location, etc.)
stage.depends_on: silver layer (accounts data from Black Diamond)
stage.notes: Foundation dimension table. All downstream scripts reference this for account metadata.

stage.produces: gold/advisor_assignments_history_latest.parquet (SCD Type 2 — tracks architect/implementor/local_relationship changes over time)
stage.notes: Slow-changing dimension. Required for historical advisor attribution.

stage.produces: gold/positions_cube/*.parquet (core fact table: every position on every date with FIFO cost basis, cumulative flows. ~500M-1B rows for full history)
stage.depends_on: silver/allocations, silver/prices (canonical 3-tier), silver/transactions. Incremental uses --start-date (default 8 days ago).
stage.notes: Computationally intensive. Full rebuild: 30-60 min on r6i.xlarge. Incremental: ~5 min. FIFO cost basis calculated per (account, asset) group. Central dependency for all downstream scripts.

stage.produces: gold/holdings_lots/*.parquet (per-lot tax information: acquisition_date, current_qty, cost_per_unit, holding_period)
stage.depends_on: 02_build_positions_cube.py (positions_cube), 00_build_accounts_dimension.py (accounts_dimension). Runs after 04 in full sequence despite lower number.
stage.notes: Tax detail layer. Enables drill-down from household summary to individual lots. Run order in full mode: 00, 01, 02, 04, 03 (note 04 before 03).

stage.produces: gold/client_dimension_latest.parquet (household-level metadata: name, location, first_seen_date, etc.)
stage.notes: Client/household dimension. Runs before 03 in full sequence.

stage.produces: gold/client_performance/*.parquet (one row per date+relationship_id: aggregated AUA, gains by account_type, short/long term breakdown)
stage.notes: Primary performance aggregation table. Central dependency for scripts 07, 08, 09, 10 and for all portal publisher outputs. AUA aggregation is the key metric.
Full history rebuild only — excluded from incremental because account-level history is expensive. Used by script 09 (partner analytics).

stage.produces: gold/views/client_tax_liability_latest.parquet (max granularity: date, relationship_id, account_id, holding_period, fiscal_year, account_tax_status)
stage.notes: Enables drill-down from household to individual lot. Short-term vs long-term holding period split. Tax-status aware.

stage.produces: Gold geo view (NNA/AUA metrics by city, state, region). City-level drill-down added 2026-03-02.
stage.notes: Geography segmentation view. Powers the distribution panel geographic drill-down in the portal. Corporate action handling added 2026-03-02 (fix in script 03 flow).

stage.produces: Gold advisor NNA/AUA view (metrics aggregated by advisor/architect)
stage.notes: Advisor segmentation view. Powers AdvisorIntelligence advisor-level breakdown. Also includes NNA and CLA/NNA segment views added 2026-03-02.

stage.produces: Partner analytics JSON outputs (summary metrics, segment analytics, leaderboards)
stage.notes: Added to gold layer EC2 runner in recent expansion (scripts 09+10 added to EC2 runner). Previously ran only in full mode. Produces JSON consumed by bd-portal-publisher and bd-portal-advisor-publisher.

stage.produces: Advisor rolling flows JSON (time-series of advisor NNA flows)
stage.notes: Rolling flows view added in gold layer expansion. Powers rolling advisor flows chart in AdvisorIntelligence portal. Added to EC2 runner in recent expansion alongside script 09.

sentinel.description: After all scripts complete, run_gold_layer.sh writes gold/pipeline-complete.json to s3://opal-data-bd/. This S3 ObjectCreated event triggers bd-portal-publisher. Script also triggers CloudFront invalidation on distribution EVTSA9VEHNZVH (path: /api/scoped/advisor-intelligence/*) and shuts down the EC2 instance.

service.name: bd-gold-layer-runner
service.deploy_note: S3-pull model. deploy pushes to s3://opal-data-bd/code/{bronze,silver,gold}/. EC2 syncs from S3 on boot via run-gold-layer.sh. Runner script itself self-updates from s3://opal-data-bd/code/runner/run-gold-layer.sh on each boot.
service.started_by: bd-gold-trigger Lambda (EC2 start via EC2 API)
service.eventbridge_emission: After every successful chain close (gold_dispatch.sh MODE=chain, DRY_RUN=0, chain_exit=0), emits a `chain-complete` event to the default EventBridge bus. Source=bd-pipeline.gold-chain, DetailType=chain-complete, Detail={chain_label, completed_at, scripts, mode, exit_code}. IAM: bd-exporter-ec2-role `events-emit` inline policy (bd-v2.24.2, ADVI_ROLLUP.DH-7). First consumer: ADVI_49EXEC.007 exec-summary-generator Lambda. Failed chains emit nothing.

service.name: bd-gold-qa-runner
service.deploy_note: QA/test twin of bd-gold-layer-runner. Same instance type (c6i.16xlarge), same S3-pull model, same bd-exporter-ec2-role. No systemd auto-start; GOLD_KEEP_ALIVE=1 so no auto-shutdown after gold_dispatch.sh completes. Manual SSM dispatch only — agents or humans start/stop/SSM this instance for test gold runs. NEVER use for PROD nightlies: bd-gold-layer-runner is EventBridge-only and the sole PROD gold runner.
service.access_policy: MANUAL RUNS ONLY. Not touched by bd-gold-trigger Lambda or EventBridge. Validate CP-DS1 / CP-AE1 / any chain-edit code path here before landing on PROD runner.
service.logs: /tmp/gold-*.log on instance; upload via gold_dispatch.sh upload_log (optional) or manual aws s3 cp

service.name: bd-allocations
service.deploy_note: Code deployed via SSM document opal-bd-allocation-download which syncs from s3://opal-data-bd/scripts/src/. Triggered daily by bd-allocation-trigger Lambda via EventBridge at 21:48 UTC weekdays.

service.name: bd-transactions
service.deploy_note: Code deployed via SSM document opal-bd-transaction-download which syncs from s3://opal-data-bd/scripts/src/. Triggered daily by bd-transactions-trigger Lambda via EventBridge at 21:40 UTC weekdays.

service.name: bd-fees
service.deploy_note: Dedicated EC2 for the BD Fees pipeline (standalone from bd-allocations to isolate failure domains). Provisioned 2026-04-10 via uploader_user_data.sh which installs bun + playwright chromium + xvfb + python libs. Code deployed via SSM document opal-bd-fees-download which syncs from s3://opal-data-bd/scripts/src/ on each run. Triggered Mon-Fri 22:15 UTC by bd-fees-trigger Lambda via EventBridge. The SSM doc runs download-daily-fees.ts (Playwright -> BD Data Mining -> Fees_OpalCapital_Daily template) and then convert_fees_to_silver.py --latest. Does NOT invoke bd-price-update or bd-gold-trigger.
service.consumers: bd-portal-publisher, bd-portal-advisor-publisher (read fees after gold completes)

service.name: bd-gold-detail-generator
service.deploy_note: Ephemeral: code is baked into user-data.sh at launch time. No persistent deploy. instance_initiated_shutdown_behavior=stop. Tagged AutoStart=StepFunctions — intended for Step Functions orchestration (planned migration).
service.last_deployed_commit: null (ephemeral, user-data baked at Terraform apply)

service.name: historical-prices-ephemeral
service.deploy_note: Launched by historical-prices-scheduler Lambda. Code baked into user-data at launch. Instance self-terminates on completion (ec2:TerminateInstances allowed on tag ManagedBy=lambda-scheduler).

rule.name: bd-transaction-pipeline-trigger
rule.schedule: cron(40 21 ? * MON-FRI *) — 21:40 UTC Mon-Fri (4:40 PM ET)

rule.name: bd-allocation-pipeline-trigger
rule.schedule: cron(48 21 ? * MON-FRI *) — 21:48 UTC Mon-Fri (4:48 PM ET)

rule.name: bd-fees-pipeline-trigger
rule.schedule: cron(15 22 ? * MON-FRI *) — 22:15 UTC Mon-Fri (6:15 PM ET)
rule.notes: Added bd-v2.23.0. Starts dedicated bd-fees EC2 which downloads the Fees_OpalCapital_Daily BD template to s3://opal-data-bd/bronze/fees/ and runs convert_fees_to_silver.py --latest to produce silver/fees/YYYY-MM-DD.parquet partitions. Scheduled 15 min after the allocation wave clears (22:00) and 45 min before the gold nightly fallback (23:00). Fees pipeline is standalone — does NOT feed the price/gold chain. Portal publishers consume silver/fees/ AFTER gold completes via the pipeline-complete.json sentinel.

rule.name: bd-gold-layer-monthly-trigger

rule.name: bd-gold-nightly-fallback
rule.schedule: cron(0 23 ? * MON-SAT *) -- 23:00 UTC Mon-Sat (7 PM EDT, 1h after silver)
rule.notes: Safety net when the S3 silver/prices trigger or the canonical-prices-daily trigger is silently dropped. Redundant defense with the pending-marker mechanism in bd-gold-trigger Lambda + run-gold-layer.sh race-safety.

rule.name: bd-canonical-prices-daily
rule.schedule: cron(0 4 * * ? *) -- 04:00 UTC every day (midnight ET EDT / 11 PM ET EST) incl. weekends/holidays
rule.notes: Added bd-v2.22.0 (ADVI_GLDRST.022 Phase 1). Moved 22:00 UTC -> 04:00 UTC at bd-v2.24.1 (2026-04-15) -- runs the full daily gold chain overnight after BD upstream waves settle (21:38-22:30 UTC weekdays), before morning portal traffic. Closes weekend/holiday coverage gap for silver/prices/canonical_prices.parquet. Runner's gold_dispatch.sh runs silver-prep (S_00 = build_canonical_prices_v2.py) before the freshness gate; on weekdays the gate passes and full A/B/C/D chain runs; on weekends/holidays the gate trips and the instance shuts down after canonical_prices is refreshed for that date. Ref: docs/briefs/ae-brief-v2-prestep-integration.md

issue.title: AUA Undercount (triple-bug)
issue.description: A triple-bug caused AUA undercount in the gold layer. All three bugs were fixed together in a single deploy. Impact: reported AUA was below actual AUM due to account filtering, position aggregation, and price lookup errors working in combination. Resolution confirmed via validate outputs vs prior system.

issue.title: bd-portal-advisor-publisher not directly S3-triggered
issue.description: S3 does not allow two notification rules with identical prefix+suffix filters on the same bucket+event type. bd-portal-advisor-publisher cannot have its own S3 notification on gold/pipeline-complete.json. Fan-out is achieved by having bd-portal-publisher async-invoke bd-portal-advisor-publisher at startup. If bd-portal-publisher fails before reaching the invoke call, bd-portal-advisor-publisher will not run.
issue.operational_note: If AdvisorIntelligence views are stale but segment analytics are fresh, suspect bd-portal-publisher crashed before reaching the advisor-publisher invoke. Check bd-portal-publisher CloudWatch logs first.

issue.title: EC2 gold runner self-update on boot
issue.description: run-gold-layer.sh self-updates from S3 on each boot. If the S3 runner copy is corrupted or missing, the instance falls back to its local copy and logs a WARN. The actual gold scripts (run_gold_layer.sh, 00-10 .py files) are always synced fresh from S3 at boot — there is no fallback if S3 sync fails (exits with error and shuts down).
issue.operational_note: If gold layer fails silently on boot, check s3://opal-data-bd/logs/gold-layer/ for the run log. If no log appears, EC2 may have shut down before S3 upload — check CloudWatch or SSM Run Command history.

issue.title: Stale IAM s3:PutObject permission on opal-data-portal-v2
issue.description: infra/aws/terraform/bd-pipeline/iam.tf line 375 grants s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::opal-data-portal-v2/* to the bd-pipeline Lambda role. The active pipeline code (bd-portal-publisher, bd-portal-advisor-publisher) writes ZERO objects to opal-data-portal-v2 — all output is opal-data-bd/gold/. This permission is a stale artifact from a prior architecture. It violates least-privilege and should be removed. Removal requires: edit iam.tf to delete the opal-data-portal-v2 statement, terraform apply, 0-diff verify, tag bd-v{next}.
issue.operational_note: Do NOT use this permission. Any Lambda that writes to opal-data-portal-v2/json/advisor-intelligence/ would violate the bucket separation invariant (see data_contracts section). The path was deleted 2026-03-10 and must never be recreated by any partner pipeline.

issue.title: Archive scripts contain opal-data-portal-v2 references
issue.description: Scripts in data/black_diamond/scripts/gold/archive/ were the pre-separation architecture. Several contain OUTPUT_BUCKET = 'opal-data-portal-v2': archive/08, 11 (leaderboards), 12, 13, allocations/generate_aua_chart.py, transactions/generate_flows_chart.py, hybrid/generate_leaderboards.py. archive/11_generate_clients_tab.py is notable: it has DUAL buckets (S3_BUCKET_BD=opal-data-bd AND S3_BUCKET_PORTAL=opal-data-portal-v2). None of these scripts are in the active pipeline. The bd-gold-detail-generator (user-data.sh) downloads from s3://opal-data-bd/scripts/gold_layer/ which may contain older versions. The version at that S3 path should be verified in the AWS console to confirm it does not contain portal-v2 writes.

contract.title: Gold Output Bucket Separation
contract.invariant: All bd-pipeline gold output writes to s3://opal-data-bd/gold/ exclusively. ZERO writes to opal-data-portal-v2 are permitted from any active pipeline component. Portal data delivery is achieved by Lambda@Edge routing to opal-data-bd — not by writing to opal-data-portal-v2.

output_pattern.rule: All portal-consumed JSON files go under the gold/ prefix
Never write to opal-data-portal-v2/ for any partner data path
CloudFront/Lambda@Edge constructs the source bucket from firmId at request time
